case: PostgreSQL scalar-enum CSV import remains schema-qualified when the role search_path changes between planning and execution
contract: CSV metadata and the insert plan are built while enum_csv_shadow_a is first in search_path and shadows the destination type name in enum_csv_shadow_b.
Before execution, the role search_path changes and a fresh connection uses enum_csv_shadow_c first, whose same-named enum has a distinct decoy-only label.
The schema-qualified insert cast restores target-only, literal NULL, empty text, and SQL NULL to enum_csv_shadow_b.state.
The target sibling is unchanged and the identically named shadow table in enum_csv_shadow_a remains empty.
